title: Hanasato Minori — A Dream Lost In The Crowds〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Dream Lost In The Crowds（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (One, two, three, four! And jump at the end!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How did I do KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that looked perfect!
It was a wonderful expression of your cheerful energy, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I did this during our last show stream, all our fans really loved it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's clear from this dance routine that you want everybody to have fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The song also suits you very well since it has a supportive feel to it. I'm sure many of your fans want to see you perform it again, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! After receiving so many comments on social media, me and the others have been talking about performing it again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we're gonna practice a lot to make sure that we put on a really powerful performance next time!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We don't want to disappoint them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I realized something after we had that dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's really, really amazing how so many people are supporting us now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you talking about when you touched those black fragments?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even in that dream, I wanted to become an idol like Haruka and the others. I was willing to do anything to achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Only a few people were looking my way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was worried that I'd never become an idol who could give people hope like Haruka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
Based on everything I've heard, it really must've been a terrible dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was. I'm so glad that it was all just a dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But then...it hit me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so lucky to have my life right now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I get to do lots of streams and perform shows on stage with the others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I have a ton of people following my work. People who are always rooting for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really can't take them for granted.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I always feel inspired to do my best for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our fans have become a huge source of hope for me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, because they've given me so much encouragement, I want to spread lots of hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It'd be so great if we could keep giving each other hope as I continue to work as an idol.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
That dream made you feel all these things?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm absolutely certain that you'll achieve your goal, Minori. You're going to become an idol who receives hope from her fans and gives hope back to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The others and I will also give you all the support we can moving forward.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, if you ever need our assistance, please feel free to ask!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you, I will!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, in order to spread hope to lots of people, I'm gonna keep doing more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, KAITO, please watch me perform that dance one more time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like I can put on an even better performance now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! I'll keep helping until you feel completely satisfied, Minori!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's work together to produce the best performance we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let me get to my position...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm ready, KAITO! Start the music!
